content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the stalls where Cusco does its daily bargaining, and let the smells of fruit and fresh bread pull you along."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A sweet little museum where cacao gets the respect it deserves, with a tasting at the end."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Under Inti (the sun) gone to rest, the dome opens a window to the southern stars."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Start with the grand square, where Cusco’s history hums under the arcades and Inti (the sun) warms the stones."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Wander the steep lanes of San Blas, full of little workshops, bright doorways and the quiet charm of local life."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb to Cristo Blanco for a sweeping view over the red rooftops as the light turns golden."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A cosy vegan table with fresh, colourful plates that please every palate in the crew."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The old Inca sun temple still glows under Cusco's light, with stonework that hums beneath the colonial walls."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Huge zigzag stones up on the hill, where the Inca walls feel like a puzzle made by giants."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold-leaf altars and cedar carvings inside, plus a painting of the Last Supper with a very Andean guest."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quiet walk through Inca cups, quipus and mummies, telling the story of the empire in small careful rooms."}]}
